messages:
Sasha: ok team, new office initiative — i made a tiny LLM that auto-replies to microwave food complaints. please roast it before i unleash it 😅
Marco: of course this exists. what does it do, like judge mysterious Tupperwares? :popcorn:
Sasha: exactly. it replies with a persona called ‘Kitchen Karen GPT’ that gives escalating levels of concern: from 'pour some water' to 'call facilities' depending on smell keywords.
Jenny: mandatory bingo card please. i call dibs on the square 'it smells vaguely of defeat' 🗳️
Ciaran: love it. add a corner square for 'this is probably fine but also cry a little' 😂
Sasha: draft bingo squares: "It'll be fine", "Please label your food", "Is that science?", "Call facilities", "Recycle that container", "It's protein we can't see". Want me to tweet it? (jk)
Amanda: can it be configured to suggest reheating settings? like "microwave at 60% for 2 min" — useful for sad leftovers.
Sasha: yeah i added a tiny prompt that maps keywords to reheating templates. snippet: ```system: you are kind but stern.
user: my lunch smells weird
assistant: empathy + one pragmatic step + request to label next time
```
Marco: please include a 'send GIF' fallback. if someone types 'burnt' it should reply with a dramatic smoky GIF.
Jenny: also add a passive-aggressive variant for repeated offenders: "This container has been in the microwave a disturbing number of times. Are you ok?" :laughing:
Ciaran: ops-bot: please do not actually auto-post in #general without human review. we love the chaos but also love our nose.
ops-bot: noted. automated-posts require +1 from 2 humans (Sasha, Marco, or Amanda).
Amanda: poll: should it escalate to facilities on smell keywords or just nudge people? react with :nudge: for nudge, :fire: for escalate.
Jenny: :nudge:
Marco: :nudge: (but also a stern admin DM after 3 nudges)
Sasha: ok we're doing a soft rollout. will post the bingo image and maybe a prompt-card for anyone who wants to spin up a 'kitchen persona' for team rituals.
Ciaran: finalize the bingo and i will buy a pack of those cheap bingo chips. office culture win.
Jenny: naming brainstorm: "Microwave Moderator", "Leftover Liaison", "KarenGPT (kitchen edition)" — pick your fighter.
Sasha: Microwave Moderator is my vote. also making a slack emoji for the 'label your food' fail.
Amanda: reminder: please don't microwave fish in the office. this bot cannot save us.
Marco: amen.
Sasha: closing notes: i'll share the bingo card and the prompt bundle in this thread tomorrow. also, anyone who gets a passive-aggressive DM owes the rest of us cookies. deal? :cookie:
